extracted.intended_audience: general readers of humorous short fiction; students of early-20th-century American narrative
extracted.subtask_description: A first‑person narrative excerpt of early-20th-century humorous short fiction (Irvin S. Cobb) recounting the antics of an older man acting like a boy and the town's reaction. Useful for readers, literary analysis, or creative-writing study of comic voice and characterization.
